tools.name: browse-country
tools.description: Open the FinancialFilings country landing page for a specific market — a curated list of listed companies and recent filings filed in that jurisdiction. Use this when the user wants to explore a market rather than a specific company (e.g. "show me filings from Germany", "what's in the FTSE 100").

country.description: Country slug (e.g. "germany", "united-kingdom", "japan", "united-states"). Use the kebab-case English name.

tools.name: search-companies
tools.description: Search FinancialFilings for listed companies by name, ticker, ISIN, or LEI. Navigates the user's browser to the search results page. Use this when the user mentions a company by name or identifier and wants to find filings, financials, or further actions for that company.

query.description: Company name, ticker (e.g. SAP, AAPL), ISIN (e.g. DE0007164600), or LEI.

tools.name: view-company
tools.description: Open the FinancialFilings company page for a specific company by its URL slug. Use this after search-companies has returned a result and the user wants to see the full filings history for that company. If the user gave a company name without a slug, call search-companies first.

slug.description: URL slug of the company (e.g. "sap-se", "volkswagen-ag"). Use the slug returned by search-companies, not the human-readable name.

tools.name: view-filing
tools.description: Open a specific regulatory filing page on FinancialFilings by its filing ID. Use this when the user asks to "see", "open", or "read" a filing they have an ID for. The ID is the integer surfaced by the REST API or MCP server.
